# Receipts from YooMoney: reference for parameter values

Below are the possible values for the following parameters of the `receipt` object as well as the request parameters for [creating a receipt](https://yookassa.ru/developers/api#create_receipt):

- [VAT rates codes](https://yookassa.ru/developers/payment-acceptance/receipts/54fz/yoomoney/parameters-values#vat-codes);
- [payment subject attributes](https://yookassa.ru/developers/payment-acceptance/receipts/54fz/yoomoney/parameters-values#payment-subject);
- [payment method attributes](https://yookassa.ru/developers/payment-acceptance/receipts/54fz/yoomoney/parameters-values#54fz-payment-mode);
- [unit of measurement of product quantity](https://yookassa.ru/developers/payment-acceptance/receipts/54fz/yoomoney/parameters-values#measure);
- [payment type](https://yookassa.ru/developers/payment-acceptance/receipts/54fz/yoomoney/parameters-values#settlement-type);
- [planned product status](https://yookassa.ru/developers/payment-acceptance/receipts/54fz/yoomoney/parameters-values#planned-status).

VAT rates codes

VAT rate code is specified in the `vat_code` parameter.

Possible value is a number from 1 to 12.

Starting from January 1, 2026, the basic VAT rate will increase from 20% to 22%, and the estimate rate from 20/120 to 22/122 (rate codes `11`, `12`). All online sales registers support the increased rates.

| Code | VAT rate |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | Excluding VAT |
| 2 | 0% VAT rate |
| 3 | 10% VAT rate |
| 4 | 20% VAT rate |
| 5 | 10/110 estimate VAT rate |
| 6 | 20/120 estimate VAT rate |
| 7 | 5% VAT rate |
| 8 | 7% VAT rate |
| 9 | 5/105 estimate VAT rate |
| 10 | 7/107 estimate VAT rate |
| 11 | 22% VAT rate |
| 12 | 22/122 estimate VAT rate |

Payment subject attributes

The payment subject attribute is specified in the `payment_subject` parameter.

Possible values:

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| commodity | Product |
| excise | Excisable products that don't need to be marked |
| job | Job |
| service | Service |
| payment | Payment |
| casino | Casino payment |
| gambling\_bet | Gambling bet |
| gambling\_prize | Gambling winnings |
| lottery | Lottery ticket |
| lottery\_prize | Lottery winnings |
| intellectual\_activity | Intellectual property |
| agent\_commission | Agent’s commission |
| property\_right | Property rights |
| non\_operating\_gain | Non-operating income |
| sales\_tax | Sales tax |
| resort\_fee | Resort fee |
| marked | Product which must be marked with the means of identification which has a marking code, except excisable products (ТМ in the receipt). Example: footwear, perfume, or light industry |
| non\_marked | Product which must be marked with the means of identification which doesn't have a marking code, except excisable products (ТНМ in the receipt). Example: fur products |
| marked\_excise | Excisable product which must be marked with the means of identification which has a marking code (АТМ in the receipt). Example: tobacco |
| non\_marked\_excise | Excisable product which must be marked with the means of identification which doesn't have a marking code (АТНМ in the receipt). Example: alcohol products |
| fine | Penalties, fines, remuneration, bonuses, and other similar payment items |
| tax | Insurance payments |
| lien | Loan |
| cost | Expenses |
| agent\_withdrawals | Cash withdrawal |
| pension\_insurance\_without\_payouts | Mandatory pension insurance payments paid by sole proprietors who don't make payouts or provide other remuneration to individuals |
| pension\_insurance\_with\_payouts | Mandatory pension insurance payments paid by companies and sole proprietors who make payouts or provide other remuneration to individuals |
| health\_insurance\_without\_payouts | Mandatory health insurance payments paid by sole proprietors who don't make payouts or provide other remuneration to individuals |
| health\_insurance\_with\_payouts | Mandatory health insurance payments paid by companies and sole proprietors who make payouts or provide other remuneration to individuals |
| health\_insurance | Mandatory social insurance payments |
| another | Another |

Payment method attributes

The payment method attribute is specified in the `payment_mode` parameter.

Possible values:

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| full\_prepayment | Full prepayment |
| full\_payment | Full payment |

Partial prepayment, advance payment, and loan are not supported.

Unit of measurement of product quantity

Unit of measurement of product quantity is specified in the `measure` parameter of the `items` array.

Possible values:

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| piece | Product item, piece, or unit |
| gram | Gram |
| kilogram | Kilogram |
| ton | Ton |
| centimeter | Centimeter |
| decimeter | Decimeter |
| meter | Meter |
| square\_centimeter | Square centimeter |
| square\_decimeter | Square decimeter |
| square\_meter | Square meter |
| milliliter | Millimeter |
| liter | Liter |
| cubic\_meter | Cubic meter |
| kilowatt\_hour | Kilowatt-hour |
| gigacalorie | Gigacalorie |
| day | Day (24 hours) |
| hour | Hour |
| minute | Minute |
| second | Second |
| kilobyte | Kilobyte |
| megabyte | Megabyte |
| gigabyte | Gigabyte |
| terabyte | Terabyte |
| another | Other |

Payment type

The payment type is specified in the `type` parameter of the `settlements` array in the request for [creating a receipt](https://yookassa.ru/developers/api#create_receipt).

Possible values:

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| cashless | Cashless payment |
| prepayment | Prepayment (advance payment) |
| postpayment | Postpayment (loan) |
| consideration | Consideration |

Planned product status

Applicable only to products subject to mandatory marking. These are the products with marking code specified in the `mark_code_info` object in one of these parameters: `gs_1m`, `short`, or `fur`.

The planned product status is set in the `items` array, in the `planned_status` parameter.

Possible values:

| Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | Piece product, sold |
| 2 | Measured product, in progress of sale |
| 3 | Piece product, returned |
| 4 | Part of the product, returned |
| 5 | Piece product, in progress of sale |
| 6 | Measured product, sold |

Time zone

Specified only if the receipt contains products that are subject to mandatory labeling. These are the products with marking code specified in the `mark_code_info` object in one of these parameters: `gs_1m`, `short`, or `fur`.

The time zone number is specified in the `timezone` parameter.

Possible values:

| Time zone number | UTC | Difference with Moscow time | Example of cities included in the time zone |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | UTC+2 | MCK-1 | Kaliningrad |
| 2 | UTC+3 | MCK | Moscow, Saint Petersburg, Nizhny Novgorod |
| 3 | UTC+4 | MCK+1 | Astrakhan, Samara, Ulyanovsk |
